long_biography.plain_text:
After studying at the University of Tromsø, Nørgaard established Delfi and Vognsen Holding in 2000. Delfi built an import-export business around high-quality fresh whitefish from the North Atlantic and controlled P/F Valhalla, a Faroese subsidiary. He has remained the seafood company's owner and director while managing the wider group from central Jutland.

Property became a second durable strand. Nørgaard bought Taarupgaard near Viborg for use as a home and rental estate, then acquired Boller from Horsens Municipality. Working with Denmark's cultural authorities, he restored the protected Renaissance complex and converted it into ten rental apartments. His current holdings also include Blikfabrikken and several registered properties, indicating that rental and investment real estate now form a substantial part of his private business portfolio.
